card.title: More Committed Than You
card.instruction: Treat belief in the scene’s strangest premise as a contest, proving your commitment through increasingly unnecessary demonstrations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You signed the pledge that the moon hears us? I'll sign with both hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One signature's enough. I'm taking it outside tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll use two pens. She should know which of us means it twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's illegible. She won't know your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write it across my bedsheet. You can carry your little page.

mechanism: A competes to prove belief that the moon hears them through multiplied signatures and a larger written display.
confusable: Unlike practical communication with an impossible entity, the unnecessary display must exceed B's commitment and remain comparative.
comparison: The pledge alternative responds to illegibility with a bedsheet-sized signature; the queen alternative escalates from chair to bed after a cushion offer.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
